cadence.releaseRhythm: package hash backup handoff before upload

phases.name: Foundation Integrity
phases.focus: Keep the static web surface stable, accessible, responsive, and explainable.
phases.exitGate: foundation, locale, experience budget, and release checks pass together

phases.name: Cinematic Interface System
phases.focus: Deepen hero, section rhythm, scroll reveals, and tactile states without overstimulation.
phases.exitGate: reduced-motion behavior and mobile frame budget remain protected

phases.name: Mobile Product Path
phases.focus: Promote the PWA-first surface into a durable mobile path before native expansion.
phases.exitGate: touch targets, installability, offline behavior, and responsive routes are verified

phases.name: Server Preservation
phases.focus: Move package candidates to the selected server only after domain, host, path, and rollback are known.
phases.exitGate: server target confirmed and checksum match recorded

phases.name: Polyglot Service Promotion
phases.focus: Keep 64 language and configuration surfaces as lightweight contracts before any service promotion.
phases.exitGate: service contract, owner, runtime cost, and rollback path are documented

phases.name: Observability And Governance
phases.focus: Add humane telemetry, release ledgers, decision logs, and agent accountability without dashboard overload.
phases.exitGate: signals are useful, minimal, privacy-aware, and tied to decisions

standingRules: UIXAppTTR remains the single active development branch
sub-agents operate as workstreams inside UIXAppTTR
no heavy dependency without a documented promotion gate
server upload remains blocked until the active target is confirmed
reduced-motion and mobile performance remain mandatory
nextLongRunMoves: expand the visible cockpit with phase progress
turn release guardrails into server-specific handoff steps after target selection
keep the 64-surface polyglot atlas dependency-free while one language at a time earns promotion
promote the mobile path from decision matrix into installable PWA hardening
add visual QA snapshots only when a page surface materially changes
